title: eludite/solution/reload
description: The Workspace window's watcher saw files change outside Eludite (brief 0073). projectFiles true: a project, .props, .targets, .sln or .slnx file changed: the host reopens the open solution (the language server reloads it; the generation advances). projectFiles false: files were added or removed under a project's folder: the generation advances so the next eludite/solution/tree evaluates the projects again (their globs). The shell asks for the tree after the answer. With no solution open the answer is the current generation and nothing happens.

generation.description: The solution generation after the call.
